svg.title: Deezer AI music audit: about 90,000 fully AI-generated tracks arrived per day in June 2026, more than half of new deliveries at peak, while AI tracks accounted for 1-3% of streams
svg.desc: A delivery funnel filled with album-cover tiles, annotated ~90,000 AI tracks a day and >50% of new deliveries at peak. The funnel narrows through a dashed detector screen labelled 99.8% reported accuracy into a thin audio trace that reaches a vinyl record on a turntable. The record is captioned 1-3% of streams, and up to 85% of streams on AI tracks were flagged fraudulent in 2025. The footer records that detected tracks leave recommendations and flagged plays leave the royalty pool.

text.font-family: Manrope, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 90,000 a day in. 1–3% of plays out.
